about: Every upstream file the platform layer work edits (touched) or no longer runs while a surface switch is on (shadowed), see ADR-0014. A change that touches or shadows an upstream file adds it here in the same commit; `pnpm run report-platform-layer-upstream` lists what upstream changed in them.

touched.reason: the registry check and upstream report scripts; dev dependencies for renderer tests (jsdom, Vue test utils, the single file component plugin)
lockfile entries for the renderer test dev dependencies
optional `platform` prop: no SponsorBlock and no YouTube HLS seek rule for other platforms; lowest variant when none is at or below the preferred quality
